column8: The original package target is represented by dedicated source tests in tidb-lexer and tidb-hash plus parser and planner consumer tests, all exercised together by the package campaign.
Every top-level test in the sole upstream test file has an exact COVERED row and executes through the dedicated Rust package test.
All upstream standard, pattern-preserving, self-escaping, and unknown-byte vectors execute exactly; an exhaustive 256-byte assertion prevents omitted cases.
